AddressBookSourceSync(8) System Manager's Manual AddressBookSourceSync(8)

NAME

AddressBookSourceSync — Syncs Contacts data with servers.

DESCRIPTION

AddressBookSourceSync syncs Contacts data with iCloud, CardDAV, and Exchange servers.

This command is not intended to be invoked directly.

 macOS 27.2 January 1, 2017 AddressBookSourceSync(8)
